text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"My next part-time gig is at the event 
hall near here. So with that said... see 
you tomorrow!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Whenever I hear 'part-time job,' that 
consultation from the other day inevitably 
crosses my mind."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...So yeah, the shopkeepers told me 
they're always super grateful to Ines!
choice_data_list:
So... you're planning a thank-you party, 
then?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! Super emotional, right? I 
definitely wanna help out with something 
like that!
choice_data_list: Why are the two of you helping?
Why are you two helping out?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Why was it again? I went to eat ramen, and 
they asked me, "Do you know Fuu?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I want to thank that hard-working girl 
someday," is what the manager told me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right!? Not "someday"—it's gotta be now! 
Bet the other store managers are thinking 
that too! Like, duh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So, that's how we ended up throwing a 
party, huh.
choice_data_list: Got it, what should I do?
Got it, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san, you down too? Nice~☆ 
Let's party together and get those vibes 
up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, to make it useful for the party, I 
decided to check on their recent work 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, just taking a peek. That was all it 
was supposed to be, but—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trainer?! Why are you here...?

text_block_list.name: Staff Leader
text_block_list.text:
Oh, an acquaintance of yours? They seemed 
lost at the part-timer reception. Looks 
like a newbie, so be sure to show 'em the 
ropes~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What the?! You're working this part-time 
gig too, Trainer? You should've said 
something earlier~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...There's no way I could tell them... 
that I got mistaken for part-time staff 
while watching from hiding and dragged 
over here."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, if there's anything you don't 
understand, just ask! This set is pretty 
unique compared to other events.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in order to see her in action up 
close, I started working as event staff—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The queue is moving~! Please don't push, 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, customer! There's a spot open over 
here! It's easier to see from the front, 
so you're in luck!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the catering arrived, so I laid 
it all out!

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Wait, you even divided it into 
small portions so it's easier to eat~! 
That's a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Comedian
text_block_list.text:
It really is fixed! Fixing up a mic that 
quick... You're amazing, y'know!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Now, go out there and make the audience 
laugh! I'm expecting your best material~♪

text_block_list.name: Staff Leader
text_block_list.text:
"Man, thank you so much! I'd heard rumors 
about how skilled you were, but you really 
exceeded expectations! I'd definitely love 
to hire you again...!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If my schedule allows, I'll 
definitely go, so please save a spot for 
me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Working with her allowed me to witness up 
close her quick attentiveness and how 
actively she moves for the sake of others.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was once again able to understand why 
she was so appreciated by the shop 
managers.
choice_data_list:
You really keep a close eye on everyone, 
huh.

You really keep a close eye on everyone, 
don't you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks. I thought your moves weren't 
half bad either, Trainer♪
choice_data_list: Any tips for getting it to work properly?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the trick, huh... I've never really 
thought about it. Part of it is just 
personality.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Still... from the way you're talking, 
that's not really what you wanted to hear, 
is it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... If I had to say, it'd be 
focusing on making them happy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
When I helped my mom out when I was 
little, she was so happy about it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That made me so happy, and that warm 
feeling in my chest at that moment felt so 
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I realized just how wonderful it feels to 
make someone happy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm still giving it my all 
today, keeping those feelings in my 
heart!"
choice_data_list: That's a wonderful way of thinking.
That's a wonderful way of thinking.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm still giving it my all 
today, keeping those feelings in my 
heart!"
choice_data_list: That's a wonderful way of thinking.
That's a wonderful way of thinking.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, because that is my entire way of 
life!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you don't act like yourself, it 
actually puts me in a bind!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in the evening sun, she looked all 
the more radiant as she said that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Right?! I totally think so too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I can't thank my mom enough for helping me 
realize that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So I'm planning to repay that kindness 
many times over someday~♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
A hidden hot spring deep in the mountains, 
or maybe a luxury hotel sounds nice too! 
Oh, traveling abroad is an option, too. 
Mmm, so hard to choose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looked so happy as she spoke... that 
it brought a smile to my own face.
